name: AGI System
tag: A ready framework for building chatbots, writing assistants and research tools on LangChain and CrewAI.

scenarios.title: Launch a support chatbot
scenarios.ask: Build a support chatbot from our {docs} help documents. We get {questions} questions a month.

inputs.label: Hand off to a person when unsure

steps: Split {docs} sample documents into {=docs * 12} searchable passages.
Set up search so each answer quotes the passages it used.
Built the LangChain conversation flow with memory for follow-up questions.
Answers only from your documents. Handoff to a person when unsure: {handoff}.
Ran 50 sample questions and scored each answer against the source.
followups: What happens with questions it can't answer?
With handoff on, it says it isn't sure and passes the chat to your team with the conversation so far. Those questions also show where your documents have gaps.
Can we use our own model?
Yes. The framework works with hosted models or local ones. You change one setting, not the app.

scenarios.title: Build a research crew
scenarios.ask: Set up a CrewAI research crew that reviews {sources} sources on a topic and writes a {pages}-page brief.
steps: Collected {sources} sources and pulled key claims from each.
Cross-checked claims and marked {=max(1, round(sources * 0.1))} that only one source supports.
Wrote a {pages} brief with a citation for every claim.
followups: They're the most likely to be wrong or out of date. You can decide to keep, verify or drop them before the brief goes out.
Can I add my own agents?
Yes. Each agent is a short config with a role, tools and goal. Add an editor or a domain expert and the crew includes it.

scenarios.title: Set up a writing assistant
scenarios.ask: Help our team of {writers} write {posts} posts a week in our brand voice.

inputs.label: Past posts to learn the voice

steps: Read {samples} past posts and wrote a style guide: tone, sentence length, words to avoid.
Drafts outlines from a topic and a few notes.
Writes first drafts in the brand voice for review.
Checks facts against your sources and flags anything unsupported.
followups: The voice guide comes from your {samples} past posts, so drafts follow your style. Writers still edit every draft.
No. It is a sample estimate based on faster outlines and first drafts. Track your own time for a month to see the real change.
